narration: Security researchers say attackers used AI tools to plan intrusions into water treatment systems, probing the control software that runs pumps and chemical dosing at municipal water plants.

research.description: A darkened municipal water treatment control room at night, illuminated only by the cool glow of multiple wall-mounted monitors showing abstract control interfaces. A silhouette of a person in an unmarked utility uniform stands before a central console, one hand touching a trackball, back to camera. Pipes and a large pressure gauge are dimly visible through a reinforced glass partition behind, with shallow depth of field. No readable text, no logos, no visible faces.
